02 / Our philosophy

Architecture begins
with listening.

To the land, to its materials, and to the people who call it home. Our work grows from what is already here.

Local wisdom. Contemporary living.
01 —

Harmony with nature

Let the sun, wind, rain, and existing trees guide the design. Make room for the landscape to live.

02 —

Local materials

Find possibility in what is close at hand. Reclaimed timber carries a history we choose to continue.

03 —

Indigenous knowledge

Learn from Southeast Asian building traditions, translating generations of wisdom into places for today.

04 —

Process participation

Bring owners, architects, and craftspeople into the making. Shared work creates a deeper sense of belonging.

03 / The practice

Many hands. One intention.

A design-build studio and a community of makers, working together since 2011.

The practice is a conversation — on site, in the workshop, together.

Based in San Kamphaeng, Chiang Mai, we bring architecture, landscape, and construction into one continuous process. The drawing table and the building site are equally places of discovery.

DechophonCo-founder / Architectural Design
PhongsathornCo-founder / Landscape
RungrojCo-founder / Construction

Alongside our founders, a builder guild of local craftspeople, foremen, and engineers turns shared knowledge into built work.
